EARLY_BIRD.name: Early Bird
EARLY_BIRD.description: Wakes up at 5 AM regardless of the schedule. Often makes too much noise in the kitchen while others sleep.

NIGHT_OWL.name: Night Owl
NIGHT_OWL.description: Cannot fall asleep before 3 AM. Usually the one keeping the room awake with their phone screen.

LIGHT_SLEEPER.name: Light Sleeper
LIGHT_SLEEPER.description: Needs total darkness and absolute silence. Frequently clashes with roommates who snore or talk late.

HEAVY_SLEEPER.name: Heavy Sleeper
HEAVY_SLEEPER.description: Could sleep through a fire alarm. Their alarms often wake up everyone except them.

NEAT_FREAK.name: Neat Freak
NEAT_FREAK.description: Requires the dorm to be spotless. Will aggressively reorganize their roommates' belongings.

CLUTTER_BLIND.name: Clutter Blind
CLUTTER_BLIND.description: Literally does not notice messes. Leaves clothes everywhere, acting as a massive friction point.

TOP_BUNKER.name: Top Bunker
TOP_BUNKER.description: Refuses to sleep on the bottom bunk. Will actively argue for the top spot on day one.

BOTTOM_BUNKER.name: Bottom Bunker
BOTTOM_BUNKER.description: Needs the bottom bunk to feel secure. Often willing to trade favors for it.

WINDOW_OPENER.name: Window Opener
WINDOW_OPENER.description: Needs fresh air at all times. Will open the dorm windows even in the dead of winter.

HEATER_HOG.name: Heater Hog
HEATER_HOG.description: Runs cold constantly. Turns the dorm thermostat up to 80 degrees, suffocating everyone else.

STRICT_VEGAN.name: Strict Vegan
STRICT_VEGAN.description: Has intense dietary restrictions. Forces production to order separate catering, isolating them at meals.

CARNIVORE.name: Carnivore
CARNIVORE.description: Refuses to eat vegetables. Relies entirely on meat and protein shakes. Smells like whey protein.

SNACK_STASHER.name: Snack Stasher
SNACK_STASHER.description: Hides the best snacks from craft services under their bed so roommates can't eat them.

THE_SHARER.name: The Sharer
THE_SHARER.description: Buys food and drinks for the entire dorm with their own money. Buys loyalty through calories.

LONG_SHOWERER.name: Long Showerer
LONG_SHOWERER.description: Spends 45 minutes in the shared dorm bathroom. A primary source of morning arguments.

COLD_SHOWERER.name: Cold Showerer
COLD_SHOWERER.description: Takes 3-minute ice-cold showers to 'build discipline'. Deeply intense.

PERFUME_BATHER.name: Perfume Bather
PERFUME_BATHER.description: Sprays an overwhelming amount of cologne every morning. Gives their roommates headaches.

AROMATHERAPIST.name: Aromatherapist
AROMATHERAPIST.description: Constantly diffusing essential oils or burning sage in the dorm to 'cleanse the energy'.

SILENCE_DEMANDER.name: Silence Demander
SILENCE_DEMANDER.description: Requires absolute quiet when they are in the room. Will explicitly tell others to shut up.

BACKGROUND_NOISE.name: Background Noise
BACKGROUND_NOISE.description: Cannot relax or sleep without a TV, podcast, or music playing out loud.

MINIMALIST_PACKER.name: Minimalist Packer
MINIMALIST_PACKER.description: Brought only two bags to the dorms. Takes up almost no space in the shared closets.

OVER_PACKER.name: Over-Packer
OVER_PACKER.description: Brought six massive suitcases. Their stuff constantly spills over into everyone else's space.

DOOR_LOCKER.name: Door Locker
DOOR_LOCKER.description: Always locks the dorm door or bathroom door, even when just grabbing something quick. Highly guarded.

OPEN_DOOR_POLICY.name: Open Door Policy
OPEN_DOOR_POLICY.description: Leaves the dorm door wide open at all times to encourage visitors. Has zero concept of privacy.

HYDRATION_FREAK.name: Hydration Freak
HYDRATION_FREAK.description: Drinks a gallon of water a day. Constantly going to the bathroom, interrupting rehearsals.
